cases.sentence: «Господин, — ответил ___, — оставь его еще на один год».
cases.translation: "Sir," the worker answered, "leave it alone one more year."
cases.explain: Работник is the subject of ответил (answered) — subjects take the nominative.

cases.sentence: У одного ___ в винограднике рос инжир.
cases.translation: A certain man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard.
cases.explain: У (at, belonging to) takes the genitive → человека, 'a certain man had...'.

cases.sentence: Придут люди с ___ и с запада, с севера и с юга.
cases.translation: People will come from east and west, from north and south.
cases.explain: С meaning 'from' takes the genitive → востока, 'from the east'.

cases.sentence: Тогда он сказал ___: «Вот уже три года я прихожу смотреть, нет ли на этом инжире плодов».
cases.translation: Then he said to the vine dresser, "Behold, for three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree."
cases.explain: Виноградарю is the indirect object of сказал (said to) → dative.

cases.sentence: Но ___ синагоги разозлило, что Иисус исцелил в субботу.
cases.translation: But the ruler of the synagogue was angered that Jesus had healed on the Sabbath.
cases.explain: Начальника is the direct object of разозлило (angered) → accusative; for animate masculine nouns the accusative equals the genitive.

cases.sentence: ...и она сразу выпрямилась и стала славить ___.
cases.translation: ...and she straightened up immediately and began to glorify God.
cases.explain: Бога is the direct object of славить (to glorify) → accusative; for animate masculine nouns the accusative equals the genitive.

cases.translation: There was a woman bent over by a spirit of infirmity.
cases.explain: Духом is an instrumental of means/agent, used without a preposition — 'bent by a spirit'.

cases.sentence: Оно, как горчичное зерно, которое человек взял и посеял в своем ___.
cases.translation: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his garden.
cases.explain: В marking location takes the prepositional; сад belongs to a small group of masculine nouns with the special locative ending -у → в саду ('in the garden').

reading.ru: Иисус ответил, «Вы думаете, что эти галилеяне так пострадали, потому что они были грешнее всех других галилеян? Нет».
reading.question: What does Jesus say about the Galileans killed by Pilate?
options: They were not worse sinners than other Galileans
They deserved their fate for their sins
Pilate was righteous to kill them
They were foreigners, not true Galileans
reading.correct: They were not worse sinners than other Galileans
reading.explain: Jesus asks if they think these Galileans suffered because they were worse sinners than others, and answers, "No."

reading.ru: Но говорю вам, если вы не раскаетесь, вы тоже погибнете, как они.
reading.question: What warning does Jesus repeat after mentioning the Galileans and the tower of Siloam?
options: Unless you repent, you will all perish as they did
reading.correct: Unless you repent, you will all perish as they did
reading.explain: Jesus warns twice that unless his listeners repent, they too will perish.

reading.ru: «Господин, — ответил работник, — оставь его еще на один год.
reading.question: What does the vineyard worker ask the owner to do with the barren fig tree?
options: Leave it one more year so he can tend it
Plant a new tree beside it
reading.correct: Leave it one more year so he can tend it
reading.explain: The worker asks the owner to leave the fig tree one more year while he digs around it and fertilizes it.

reading.ru: Она не могла выпрямиться вот уже восемнадцать лет.
reading.question: How long had the bent woman been unable to straighten up?
reading.explain: The woman had been bent over, unable to straighten up, for eighteen years.

reading.ru: Так не нужно ли было освободить в субботу и эту женщину, одну из дочерей Авраама, вот уже восемнадцать лет связанную сатаной?
reading.question: How does Jesus defend healing the woman on the Sabbath?
options: He asks whether this daughter of Abraham should not be freed on the Sabbath too
He says the Sabbath law does not apply to him
He says healing is never permitted on the Sabbath
He apologizes for breaking the rule
reading.correct: He asks whether this daughter of Abraham should not be freed on the Sabbath too
reading.explain: Jesus argues that if animals are freed to drink on the Sabbath, this woman, bound by Satan eighteen years, should surely be freed too.

reading.ru: Оно, как горчичное зерно, которое человек взял и посеял в своем саду.
reading.question: What does Jesus compare God's Kingdom to in the first parable of this section?
options: A mustard seed that grows into a large tree
A grain of wheat that never sprouts
reading.correct: A mustard seed that grows into a large tree
reading.explain: God's Kingdom is compared to a mustard seed which grows into a tree where birds nest in its branches.

reading.ru: Оно как закваска, которую женщина смешала с тремя мерами муки, чтобы вскисло все тесто».
reading.question: What does Jesus compare God's Kingdom to in the second parable?
options: Yeast that leavens the whole batch of dough
A treasure buried in a field
reading.correct: Yeast that leavens the whole batch of dough
reading.explain: God's Kingdom is like yeast a woman mixed into flour until it leavened the whole batch of dough.

reading.ru: Старайтесь войти через узкую дверь, потому что многие будут пытаться войти, но не смогут.
reading.question: What does Jesus urge people to do regarding entering God's Kingdom?
options: Strive to enter through the narrow door
Wait for someone else to open the door
reading.correct: Strive to enter through the narrow door
reading.explain: Jesus tells people to strive to enter through the narrow door, since many will try and fail.

reading.ru: и последние будут первыми, а первые последними.
reading.question: What reversal does Jesus describe regarding people entering God's Kingdom?
options: The last will be first, and the first will be last
Only the rich will enter first
Everyone will enter at the same time
The first will remain first forever
reading.correct: The last will be first, and the first will be last
reading.explain: Jesus says that the last will be first, and the first will be last.

reading.ru: Пойдите и передайте этой лисице, я буду изгонять демонов и исцелять людей сегодня и завтра, а на третий день я закончу свое дело.
reading.question: How does Jesus respond to the warning that Herod wants to kill him?
options: He tells them to call Herod a fox and says he will continue his work until the third day
He immediately flees to another country
He agrees to stop healing people
He asks to meet with Herod personally
reading.correct: He tells them to call Herod a fox and says he will continue his work until the third day
reading.explain: Jesus tells them to tell "that fox" Herod that he will keep casting out demons and healing until his work is finished.

reading.ru: О Иерусалим! Иерусалим, убивающий пророков и побивающий камнями посланных к тебе!
reading.question: What does Jesus lament about Jerusalem?
options: That it kills the prophets and stones those sent to it
That it welcomes all the prophets
That it will never be destroyed
reading.correct: That it kills the prophets and stones those sent to it
reading.explain: Jesus laments over Jerusalem, which kills the prophets and stones those sent to her.
